name: onyx-desktop
description: Coding agents, multimodal chat, and voice in one Rust-native desktop app

scripts.dev:rust: npm run build:rust-styles && node scripts/run-trunk.mjs serve --config Trunk.rust.toml --enable-cooldown
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:rust
scripts.build:rust: npm run build:rust-styles && node scripts/run-trunk.mjs build --config Trunk.rust.toml --release
scripts.test: npm run test:release-tools && npm run test:rust-ui && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.typecheck: cargo check --manifest-path frontend-rs/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
